title: HTTP request smuggling runner: detect CL.TE, TE.CL, and TE.TE desync vulnerabilities in reverse proxy setups
goal: HTTP request smuggling is absent from AegisPT and is not detected by ZAP by default. It is a critical vulnerability in apps behind load balancers/reverse proxies (nginx, HAProxy, AWS ALB) that can lead to request hijacking, XSS, cache poisoning, and access to internal endpoints. Implement an http-smuggling runner: (1) Detection only (no exploitation): send probes for: CL.TE (Content-Length + Transfer-Encoding conflict): send request where Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked conflict in a way that causes backend/frontend disagreement. Detect by timing difference in response (delayed response → smuggling possible). (2) TE.CL: similar but reversed. (3) TE.TE obfuscation: Transfer-Encoding: xchunked, Transfer-Encoding: chunked2 to bypass frontend parsing. (4) Use h2smugl or smuggler.py for detection. All probes measure timing differences — a 10+ second delay on the 'confirming request' confirms smuggling. Active tier. (5) Findings: 'HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE) - Timing Confirmed', severity Critical. (6) Only run when target is behind a known proxy (X-Forwarded-For present or Via header). Do not run against single-server targets.
scope: HTTP Request Smuggling not in AegisPT tooling. James Kettle (PortSwigger) research shows this is exploitable on many major platforms. Burp Suite Pro has a dedicated smuggling scanner. Critical for enterprise apps behind load balancers.
generation_reason: HTTP request smuggling is critical for apps behind proxies — Burp Suite has dedicated scanner, AegisPT has none. Timing-based detection only, no exploitation.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Timing-based detection only. Never construct a 'confirming request' that causes visible side effects for other users. Stop after timing confirmation.
constraints.safety: Only probe targets identified as being behind a proxy (X-Forwarded-For or Via header present). Timeout per probe: 5 seconds max.

success_criteria: http-smuggling runner detects CL.TE via timing difference.
Only runs when proxy headers present.
Produces Critical finding on confirmed desync.
